keyEvents.text: Goal! Oxford City 0, Leicester City 1. Louis Page (Leicester City) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Bobby De Cordova-Reid.
Luke Thomas (Leicester City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Oxford City 1, Leicester City 1. Scott Pollock (Oxford City) left footed shot from a difficult angle and long range on the right to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Substitution, Leicester City. Harry Howell replaces Caleb Okoli.
Goal! Oxford City 1, Leicester City 2. Emil Riis (Leicester City) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Harry Howell with a cross.
Goal! Oxford City 1, Leicester City 3. Kamari Doyle (Leicester City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Louis Page.
Goal! Oxford City 2, Leicester City 3. Josh Ashby (Oxford City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Zac McEachran.
Substitution, Oxford City. Briar Bateman replaces Zac McEachran.
Substitution, Leicester City. Olabade Aluko replaces Kamari Doyle.
